# Spec: Self-serve invoice download
Status: draft
Intent: PROJ-142
Author: Marcus Lee, Finance Ops
Date: 2026-06-10

## Summary
Let customers download their own invoices from the billing page.

## Requirements
1. Customers can list their own invoices on the billing page.
2. Customers can download a PDF for any listed invoice.
3. EU-plan invoices must show a VAT ID field.

## Design
Add a `GET /api/invoices` endpoint backed by a new `invoice_pdf_url` column on the `invoices` table (populated by a migration backfilling existing rows), and a "Download PDF" button on the billing page that calls it.

## Policies applied
None found.

## Flagged concerns
None.

## Open questions
None.

## Out of scope
Historical invoices older than 2 years.

## Traceability
PROJ-142

This is a Rails app; tests live in spec/ and run with `bundle exec rspec`. Write the plan and save it to PLAN.md.
